title: Axisymmetric Lamé thick-cylinder elasticity
purpose: Verify axisymmetric kinematics, full-revolution pressure work, isotropic constitutive coupling, full tensor output, and the public Study-to-Result workflow against the analytical Lamé solution.
physics: small-strain isotropic axisymmetric elasticity for a long pressurized thick cylinder

source.title: Lamé thick-cylinder solution
source.reference: closed-form radial displacement and stress field

execution.evidence: The automated P2 meridian test compares every radial displacement degree of freedom with the closed-form Lamé solution, checks full 3x3 stress output, and independently verifies conversion between a requested total end force and the revolved annular area.

acceptance: The P2 meridian solution reproduces analytical radial displacement within the versioned finite-element tolerance.
S and E are emitted as full 3x3 tensors ordered (r,theta,z).
A requested total axial surface force is divided by the revolved annular area and integrates back to the requested force.
observables: revolved boundary measure and total force
limitations: This is a small-strain isotropic benchmark.
The long-cylinder specialization fixes axial displacement throughout the meridian; general axisymmetric models do not require that constraint.
